Name: SoftMod
Description: This will add a soft mod to a given vertex

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will add a soft mod to a given vertex.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetTargetVertex: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetControlParent: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
